notes.title: 1.5.6 Bug fixes and updates announcement
notes.notes:
Based on everyone's feedback, we have optimized the following content in this update:
1. A multilingual error
2. Icons in the game taskbar
3. The handle accelerates and occasionally causes abnormal walking
4. Characters occasionally walk backwards
5. Item details cannot be viewed in the item column

Thank you for your understanding and support. Have a pleasant game

notes.title: Chinese folk horror puzzle game 'Winter Clothing' is now available
notes.notes:
Dear explorers,

 "Winter Clothing" is now available~[b] 10% off for the first two weeks [/b] [/u]


[h2] [Game Introduction] [/h2]
On the first day of October in the Tianhe calendar, 2010, during the Cold Clothes Festival, the mysterious disappearance of an old man revealed secrets that had been hidden for many years in two villages in Tianhe Town. As more and more clues were discovered, the truth seemed to be right in front of us
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349578/e4499b2eb62d5e67558576af209621d75a01cc55.png[/img]
Mountain Ghost Chronicles: Cold Clothes "is a horror plot puzzle game with Chinese folk themes. There is an unwritten rule in Tianhe Town: on the day of the Cold Clothes Festival, no villager is allowed to approach the back mountain. If they provoke any mountain gods or wild ghosts as a result, the leaders of Qingfeng Temple will not intervene. Grandpa's disappearance brought Chen to the foot of the mountain. Is there really a ghost on the mountain? Perhaps there is something more terrifying than ghosts.
This work takes the traditional Chinese festival of "Cold Clothes Festival" as a reference to introduce the grievances and entanglements that occurred in Tianhe Town more than twenty years ago. A large number of traditional folk cultural elements, such as animal immortals, soul summoning, night weddings, burning paper, possession, taboos, etc., have been integrated into the game plot and puzzle solving sections. In the game scene, there will also be some "cultural relics and antiques" to help you unravel the mystery
 
[h3] Walking to the front of the hall, please light three incense sticks - Chinese folk horror suspense narrative [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349578/459657af4b72fc3c4c9e3be296f1c72ddbd78312.jpg[/img]
In isolated mountain villages, people's beliefs are often controlled by those in power. Once upon a time, the "Great Immortal" who was active in the north and south alleys of the village could no longer guide the maze. If you want a peaceful home, you need three incense sticks in front of the temple and become a "person with yuan".
The "Chen Yi" played by the player can use the "summoning" method to see the deceased's soul and the past that they want you to see, but be careful, the recruited person may not necessarily be the one you want to see
 
[h3] Please note that no one should be easily trusted, including yourself - some of the plot is adapted from real cases [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349578/47c8566aa1bcc2b9ba866956e42efcd715caf5ae.jpg[/img]
They come from different places, their bodies are imprisoned here, and their souls cannot find their way home. They go to different places, this is not their hometown, nor is it their destination. The sound of tires pressing over dirt roads can be heard from the alleys on autumn nights, and tomorrow will be another lively day.
If everyone who approaches you has a purpose, then please enjoy their performance quietly
 
[h3] Go to the secluded mountain village and uncover the hidden secrets - Immersive rural folk heartbeat adventure [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349578/bdabfaa0e2af371e352d7cae20813c850c5ba20d.jpg[/img]
Unmanned Taoist temples, eerie streets, tranquil villages, and forbidden back mountains, each scene immerses you in a unique art style.
Each character has their own characteristics, even a different face
    
It's a bit scary, really just a little bit. Bold players suggest playing before bedtime, while timid players suggest finding a bold player to hold and play with.
 
[h3] Breaking through layers of fog, accompanying TA to perfection - immersive puzzle exploration [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349578/9189a780f46f221d39d862784fac54f5c5c77eab.jpg[/img]
Search for items, mechanisms, and password locks, don't worry, they will leave you clues.
Multiple endings, every choice and modification you make determines your outcome. But this time you can get the 'regret medicine', find as much of it as possible before the ending, and use it to modify the answer to the problem


Thank you again for your continued support. Wishing all explorers safe entry and exit, and a smooth sailing.


Greeting from the project team of "Winter Clothing"

notes.title: Announcement of Closed Test Recruitment
notes.notes:
Dear bosses
First of all, thank you all for your support of "Mountain Ghost Chronicles: Cold Clothes" (hereinafter referred to as "Cold Clothes"). With everyone's anticipation, "Cold Clothes" is about to enter the closed beta stage. On the basis of absorbing valuable suggestions from everyone, this test has been redone from the previously released demo version and has opened up new content for chapters 2-3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349578/b483fba458cde3de07b2fa682d2164d746e62a03.jpg[/img]
The mysterious veil of Tianhe Town is about to be unveiled, with more gameplay and stories waiting for you to explore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349578/f306bb361427c6069b8854cf8930de1626ae8117.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349578/9337a69aa9a1c3c6c44e5a3adeb484bd73b895e5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349578/5103a224f112b585885f3da62eb168d0313b3d37.jpg[/img]
I believe everyone is very concerned about how to obtain the activation code for this closed test. Without further ado, let's take a look at the content of this event!

[b] Event time: 24:00 from April 8, 2025 to April 14, 2025;
Announcement of award list: April 15, 2025;
Closed testing period: April 16, 2025- April 18, 2025 [/b]

[h3] Activity content 1: Share comments to participate in the lottery, implant your hot comments into the game! [/h3]
During the event, we will use official accounts to publish videos on Station B, Tiktok, Kwai, Weibo, WeChat video number and Little Red Book. After forwarding official videos on any platform and adding "Cold Clothes" to the wish list, we will publish screenshots under the official videos of the above platforms in the form of comments, which will be deemed as successful participation (note: interesting and obstructive comments will also be implanted into the game as colored eggs). We will start from the 20th floor and select the 20th * nth player (n=1... 5) to join this closed test. If there is a repeat, it will be postponed by one player.

[h3] Activity content 2: Participate in the competition for activation codes and testing qualifications for secondary innovation [/h3]
During the event, explorers can edit and create artwork based on official videos and images, or make bold guesses about the actors and characters they expect to play. Text, images, and videos are all available, with no restrictions on type or style. If the playback/reading volume exceeds 500, or if the cumulative number of published secondary creative works exceeds 5, you can contact the group administrator. After the event, we will rank according to the content created. The top 20 explorers will become the lucky explorers for this closed test. If there are duplicates, they will be postponed one place.
Distribution quantity:
1. Activity 1, a total of 30
2. QQ group entrepreneurship activity * 20.
Release requirements: The content posted by explorers must not contain content that is contrary to the interests of the motherland, violates laws and regulations, violates public order and good customs, or affects social harmony; It is not allowed to publish content that includes regional discrimination, racial discrimination, incitement to confrontation, and personal attacks; Do not publish any content unrelated to this game; It is not allowed to obtain activation code rewards through improper operations such as continuous floor brushing and repeated deletion.
Any violation of the above regulations, once discovered, will result in the cancellation of the user's activity qualification and a delayed issuance of a closed test activation code reward.
Activity requirements: All players participating in this closed beta test need to download, print, and sign a confidentiality agreement (attached below), scan and send it to the official customer service in order to obtain the beta activation code.
All game content and materials during the closed testing period shall not be disclosed to the public until the game is officially launched and released. Any violation will be pursued in accordance with the confidentiality agreement, depending on the severity of the situation!
[u] [b] This test is a file deletion test. After the test is completed, the saved files of the participating players will be deleted. [/b] [/u]
[u] Activity 1 and Activity 2 can be repeated, but each person can only receive one activation code

The activation code obtained cannot be resold or added to others, and can only be used by the recipient to activate it. The list of winners will be based on the user ID at the time of publication.
Award winning users, please contact the official account or administrator and leave your QQ number and mobile phone number in advance so that we can contact you later.
Thank you for your attention and support. Let's make an appointment in this golden autumn, don't see each other!

For more intelligence benefits, please follow the official account:
Official QQ group: 1015798647
Tiktok: 山鬼志寒衣
Bilibili: 山鬼志寒衣
Weibo: 山鬼志寒衣
WeChat Video Account: 山鬼志寒衣
Kwai: 山鬼志寒衣
Xiaohongshu: 山鬼志寒衣



All developers of the "Mountain Ghost Chronicles: Cold Clothes" project team
♥ 2025.4.8 ♥

notes.title: Free trial version now updated
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, based on your feedback, we have made some optimizations and adjustments to this trial package~

The updated content is as follows:

1. Optimized the plot rhythm of the prologue and improved the vague plot

2. Added two puzzle-solving methods to the prologue

3. Added multi-language packages for Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, English, Thai, and Vietnamese

Thank you for your attention and support, and wish you all a happy game~

notes.title: The new product festival trial of started~Let's solve the puzzle together！
notes.notes:
Hello everyone

With excitement and nervousness, 'Winter Clothing' is finally going to meet everyone! We will continue to live stream trial content for everyone during the New Product Festival~

The current trial version only includes partial content from the first chapter of the game, for testing purposes only, and does not represent the final quality.

If you encounter any problems, please feel free to join the official QQ group and contact us. Wishing you all a pleasant gaming experience.
